Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JACOB, a frail but determined man. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Privilege To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live. Please Welcome The One And Only JACOB.

The room erupts in applause as Jacob takes the stage. He is handed the plaque, and with a hint of a smile, he accepts it.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jacob lies in bed, the plaque from earlier sitting on his nightstand. He gazes at it, a mix of emotions on his face. Suddenly, his eyes wander to a dusty old book on his shelf. He gets out of bed and walks over to it.

JACOB
(whispering to himself)
Quantum Immortality...

He opens the book, and a yellowed page falls out. Jacob's eyes scan the text, his expression changing from curiosity to concern.

JACOB
(reading)
"If The Multiverse Is Infinite, And Every Possible Branch Exists, Then It Is Possible That I Am The Only One Who Has Survived Every Possible Death. I Am The Only One Who Has Lived An Infinite Number Of Lives."

Jacob's eyes widen as the implications sink in. He starts to feel a sense of unease, his mind racing with the possibilities.

JACOB
(whispering)
What If I'm Not Just One Person? What If I'm A Collection Of People, Living An Infinite Number Of Lives?

The room begins to spin, and Jacob's grip on reality starts to slip. He stumbles back to bed, the plaque still clutched in his hand.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S BEDROOM - LATER

Jacob lies in bed, his eyes closed, his mind consumed by the theory. He starts to see visions of himself, living multiple lives, experiencing different realities. The visions become more and more distorted, until Jacob's body starts to shake uncontrollably.

JACOB
(screaming)
I'M NOT JUST ONE PERSON! I'M A COLLECTION OF PEOPLE! I'M A MULTITUDE OF LIVES!

The room erupts in chaos as Jacob's mental breakdown reaches its peak. The camera zooms out, showing the plaque on his nightstand, the book still open on the floor.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. JACOB'S HOUSE - DAY

The plaque is seen on the front porch, still clutched in Jacob's hand. The camera pans up to reveal a sign on the door, reading "Quantum Immortality: The Theory That Changed Everything".

FADE TO BLACK.
